description_en: Modifies the URL rewrite configuration of a site
name: UpdateRewriteUrlRule

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2867480.html operation to obtain the configuration ID
parameters.name: config_id

parameters.help_en: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The rule switch. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
The rule content. A conditional expression is used to match user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example, (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.name: rule

parameters.help_en:
The path rewrite type. Valid values:
static: static pattern.
dynamic: dynamic pattern
parameters.help_zh:
路径重写类型。取值范围：
static：静态模式。
dynamic：动态模式
parameters.name: rewrite_uri_type

parameters.help_en:
The query character string rewrite type. Valid values:
static: static pattern.
dynamic: dynamic pattern
parameters.help_zh:
查询字符串重写类型。取值范围：
static：静态模式。
dynamic：动态模式
parameters.name: rewrite_query_string_type

parameters.help_en: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行
parameters.name: sequence
